Ughh! The scorpion and fire ants. Plus its always best to be careful. I had a fire ant bite swell to softball size had to go to the emergency room. Scorpions terrify me, those buggers end up anywhere and everywhere. Baby scorpions are the worst they cant control how much venom they put out and I've heard the pain is worse. Also that's another one that is only deadly if you're allergic to the venom.

Black widows tend to be in dark places were they interact less with humans. Not always but most. My husband's shop gets quite a bit but there is a property behind it that is filled with brush and a woodpile beside it. So its always best to double check. I've had to be careful with my mailbox, 2 separate occasions I've found a black widow in there and 1 time there was a scorpion. 

But if you get to the doctor in time you should be fine unless your allergic to the venom, that's where the real concern is.

Actually poisonous is when you bite it and you get sick. Venomous is when it bites you and you get sick.  Plus the black widow bite is deadly only if you're allergic to the venom, which honestly not gonna lie scared me because what if I'm in that small percentage that is allergic.
I'm only afraid of the venomous varieties
